sources.title: 한국민족문화대백과사전《명곡집 / 明谷集》（崔錫鼎）1721年刊／34卷17冊书目记述
sources.provider: Academy of Korean Studies, Encyclopedia of Korean Culture (signed scholarly encyclopedia entry)
sources.quality_notes: Author 崔錫鼎; encyclopedia says 1721 34卷17冊 woodblock and names NLC/SNU Kyujanggak/Jangseogak in aggregate without specific barcoded copy or v13 folio. Distinct MKS/Korean 文集叢刊DB KYmJ says 1721 大邱監營 first woodblock 34卷15冊, 1435板, facsimile NLC 한46-가1170 with SNU 奎1077 substitution only for some v22-v24 leaves. Different fascicle counts are a bibliographic tension, NOT proof of separate original impressions, two independently collated physical witnesses, target v13 image or G893 少/微 numeric unit. Count and binding remain unresolved.
